name: How long does kitchen cabinet replacement take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen cabinet replacement take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard kitchen cabinet tear-out and installation typically takes 3 to 5 business days, but the overall kitchen turnaround depends on surrounding trades. Removing old cabinets often reveals uneven drywall, hidden plumbing, or electrical lines that require adjustment before hanging new boxes. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra leads the finish carpentry on-site while coordinating licensed plumbing and electrical sub-trades. Adding custom moldings, countertop templating, and new tile backsplashes will extend the complete remodel timeline to several weeks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet removal and installation usually takes 3 to 5 days, though coordinating related plumbing, electrical, and countertop work extends the overall project timeline.
